scenes: What makes a heat plan complete?

The World Health Organization lists eight core elements. | From who leads, and the warnings, to the people most at risk and how messages reach them; | from clinics, and cutting exposure, to tracking illness, and learning after every season.
The one most often missed is learning: | a review after each season, so next year’s plan is better.
A checklist to run before the heat, not during it.
